questions.quote: 1. Which of the following has the smallest mass? a. 6.023 × 10^23 atoms of He b. 1 atom of He c. 2 g of He d. 1 mole atoms of He

en.q: Atoms and Molecules: Which of the following has the smallest mass?
en.explanation: 1 atom of He has a mass of about 6.6 × 10⁻²⁴ g; the other three are all about 2 g or more.

ta.q: கீழ்க்கண்டவற்றுள் எது குறைந்த நிறையைக் கொண்டது?
ta.explanation: ஒரு He அணுவின் நிறை ஏறக்குறைய 6.6 × 10⁻²⁴ கி; மற்றவை ஏறக்குறைய 2 கி அல்லது அதற்கு மேல்.

questions.quote: 2. Which of the following is a triatomic molecule? a. Glucose b. Helium c. Carbon dioxide d. Hydrogen

en.q: Atoms and Molecules: Which of the following is a triatomic molecule?
en.explanation: CO₂ has three atoms per molecule; He is monoatomic, H₂ diatomic, and glucose has 24 atoms.

ta.q: கீழ்க்கண்டவற்றுள் மூவணு மூலக்கூறு எது?
ta.explanation: CO₂-இல் ஒரு மூலக்கூறுக்கு மூன்று அணுக்கள்; He ஓரணு, H₂ ஈரணு, குளுக்கோஸில் 24 அணுக்கள்.

en.explanation: 4.4 g = 0.1 mole of CO₂ (M = 44 g); volume = 0.1 × 22.4 = 2.24 L.

questions.quote: 6. Which of the following statement is incorrect? a. 12 gram of C-12 contains Avogadro's number of atoms. b. One mole of oxygen gas contains Avogadro's number of molecules. c. One mole of hydrogen gas contains Avogadro's number of atoms. d. One mole of electrons stands for 6.023 × 10^23 electrons.

en.q: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: 12 g of C-12 contains Avogadro's number of atoms
One mole of electrons stands for 6.023 × 10²³ electrons
One mole of hydrogen gas contains Avogadro's number of atoms
One mole of oxygen gas contains Avogadro's number of molecules
en.explanation: One mole of hydrogen gas (H₂) contains Avogadro's number of molecules, i.e. twice that number of atoms.
